title: 19 August 2009: Paul McCartney live at Cowboys Stadium, Dallas
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Cowboys Stadium in Dallas, Texas, USA, on 19 August 2009.

It was the final show of the Summer Live ’09 Tour, which lasted for 10 dates in July and August 2009. This show was seen by 35,903 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

The setlist was unusual for its inclusion of Buddy Holly’s ‘It’s So Easy!’, performed as a tribute to the Texas-born singer. McCartney described it as the first time he’d performed the song.
